PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Designed around your signal chain.

The 3U OpenVPX Versal Based Radar Signal & Data Processing System is a compact digital processing platform built around AMD Versal technology. It combines a processing system and programmable logic to support real-time radar signal processing, data handling and system control.

The platform provides dedicated DDR4 memory for the processing system and programmable logic, together with Ethernet and optical connectivity for radar data exchange. External reference, synchronization and 1PPS inputs support timing coordination, while OpenVPX backplane interfaces enable integration into modular radar systems.

Versal processing platform: Combines embedded processing and programmable logic for configurable radar signal and data processing in a compact 3U platform.

External timing support: Reference, synchronization and 1PPS inputs support coordination with radar system timing.

Dedicated processing memory: Separate 16 GB DDR4 banks for the processing system and programmable logic.

High-speed optical connectivity: Eight GTY lanes connected through a FireFly optical interface at up to 25 Gbps per lane.

Ethernet and digital interfaces: Dual Gigabit Ethernet, 10 Gigabit Ethernet and LVDS support radar data exchange.

Storage and service interfaces: M.2 SSD, microSD, QSPI flash, EEPROM, USB, serial communication and debug connections support system operation.
